rules.name: xoga713-var-producer-run-check
rules.sql: SELECT tenant_id, created_by, count(*) AS row_count, min(created_timestamp) AS first_written, max(created_timestamp) AS last_written FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = upper(:bu) AND value_date = :vd GROUP BY tenant_id, created_by ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT count(*) AS loaded_rows_left FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = upper(:bu) AND value_date = :vd AND created_by = 'var-acct-load'

SELECT count(*) AS engine_rows, count(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS tenants, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1)) AS rows_with_valuation_tenant FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = upper(:bu) AND value_date = :vd AND upper(created_by) = 'SYSTEM'

SELECT upper(business_unit) AS business_unit, value_date, created_by, count(*) AS row_count, max(created_timestamp) AS last_written FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(created_by) = 'SYSTEM' AND created_timestamp > now() - interval '12 hours' AND upper(business_unit) <> upper(:bu) GROUP BY upper(business_unit), value_date, created_by ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS result_rows, count(DISTINCT aggregation_level) AS levels, max(created_timestamp) AS last_written FROM opera.var_report_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = upper(:bu) AND value_date = :vd
SELECT count(*) AS view_rows, min(value_date) AS first_date, max(value_date) AS last_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE lower(business_unit) = lower(:bu)
SELECT BINARY derivative_type AS derivative_type_exact, count(*) AS row_count FROM dbsystemuat.var_accounting_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :vd GROUP BY BINARY derivative_type ORDER BY 1
SELECT derivative_type AS derivative_type_exact, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = upper(:bu) AND value_date = :vd GROUP BY derivative_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT upper(derivative_type) AS dtype, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, strike, p1_settleprice, delta, gamma, vega, theta AS settle_theta, mtm_usd, mtm_nc, delta1 AS delta_2, gamma1 AS gamma_2, vega1 AS vega_2 FROM dbsystemuat.var_accounting_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :vd

SELECT upper(derivative_type) AS dtype, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, strike, p1_settleprice, delta, gamma, vega, settle_theta, mtm_usd, mtm_nc, delta_2, gamma_2, vega_2 FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = upper(:bu) AND value_date = :vd AND upper(created_by) = 'SYSTEM'

expect.reason: the run wrote rows (created_by SYSTEM) for the business unit and value date
the engine replaced the loaded snapshot for that business unit and date (it deletes first)
the engine wrote under the tenant of valuation_date_table; otherwise the accounting views (joined on tenant_id) show nothing
only the requested business unit was written; any row here means the unfiltered pricing cache view wrote other business units
the run wrote VaR results (var_report_table) for the business unit and date
Combined VAR reads this view for the business unit
every legacy row of that date is in the engine output
the engine wrote no row that legacy does not have
the engine values equal the legacy producer (greeks, mark-to-market, second leg for CM WP)
